Definition
[Banach-manifold charts for maps (Definition K.5)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0352, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0353 1. appk:K.5\group Mapping Spaces

For closed manifolds, the space $C^k(\mathcal M,\mathcal N)$ is charted at $f$ by sections of $f^*T\mathcal N$ via \[ \varphi _f(\sigma )(x)=\exp ^{g_{\mathcal N}}_{f(x)}\sigma (x). \] For manifolds with boundary, choose a uniformly equivalent product metric with totally geodesic boundary and restrict to sections tangent to the boundary.
